title: Amazon Echo Frames 1st gen (Day 1 Edition) introduced at $179.99, audio-only
detail: Invitation-only first-generation Echo Frames launched at $179.99; audio-only with no camera and no display.

title: Echo Frames 2nd gen announced at $249.99 (shipped 2020-12-10)
detail: Second-generation Echo Frames announced at $249.99 and shipped 2020-12-10; still audio-only.

title: Echo Frames 2nd-gen refresh with new colours and lens options
detail: Refresh of the 2nd-gen Echo Frames with new colours and lens options; no hardware change in camera (none present).

title: Echo Frames 3rd gen from $269.99 (Carrera variants $389.99), no camera, no display
detail: Third-generation Echo Frames announced from $269.99 (Carrera-branded $389.99); 15% thinner, 6 h battery; explicitly no camera and no display; shipped Dec 2023.

title: Reuters: Amazon developing driver glasses 'Amelia' with display and camera
detail: Reuters (via SiliconANGLE) reported Amazon is building delivery-driver glasses codenamed 'Amelia' on the Echo Frames base with a 'tiny embedded display' for navigation plus a camera to photograph delivered packages; 'could take years'.

title: Parola Analytics: Amazon AR patents linked to Jayhawk are UI/fulfilment only, no optics/AF
detail: Parola Analytics reviewed Amazon AR patents linked to 'Jayhawk' (US 10,055,645; 9,158,115; 10,319,150; 10,754,418; 10,176,636; 10,008,039), all 2015–2020 UI/fulfilment patents; no optics, autofocus or tunable-lens claims.

title: Amazon: 275,000 deliveries with glasses; +5,000 devices in 2026, 20,000+ by end-2027
detail: Amazon blog update: over 18 months, 500+ drivers completed 'more than 275,000 customer deliveries' with the glasses; '5,000 additional devices deploying this year' and 'over 20,000 devices by end of 2027'; new wrong-address detection and pet alerts.
